name: DART Internet
summary: Consumer ISP (dart.net.au), CEO James Austin; unlimited ADSL/ISDN on Connect/AAPT backbone (originally Comindico); acquired Ultrawave Internet and 'G4 ISPs' 2003; entered external administration ~Nov 2004; customer base handed to Hotkey. Distinct from Dart Global (dart.com.au, ACN 090 727 861).

events.details: dart.net.au registered 2001 (placeholder page), active as DART Internet (James Austin, CEO) from 2003; based Brisbane (PO Box 10308 Adelaide St, Brisbane QLD).
Entered external administration ~Nov 2004 (PwC, Brisbane); customer base handed to Hotkey. ABN 'DART INTERNET PTY LTD' cancelled.

refs.label: Whirlpool: 'DART billing issues' - James Austin: PWC administrators, 'it's up to PWC and Hotkey' (Nov 2004)

events.details: Distinct from Dart Global Pty Ltd (dart.com.au, ACN 090 727 861, Zetland NSW) - the two 'Dart' ISPs disputed the name/trademark.
